Subject: Re: Fairview onboarding: W-8BEN-E and PO timing

Hi Sara —

Thanks — we received the W-8BEN-E. Quick summary of what we need and acceptable alternatives for non-US suppliers: 

- Primary: Completed W-8BEN-E with an original signature (notarized) plus a bank letter confirming account name/EIN equivalent.
- Acceptable alternatives where notarization is not possible: 1) DocuSign with identity-certificate attached to the envelope; 2) Apostille for jurisdictions that support it; 3) A time-stamped video-attestation recorded via our partner vendor (we can share the instructions).

For PO timing: once our Vendor Ops team verifies the tax form + bank proof and we receive a completed supplier profile, Procurement typically issues an initial PO within 3 business days. If we need additional verifications (UBO, additional signatory evidence), that can add 2–4 business days.

Action items for you:
- Confirm whether you can provide DocuSign with certificate or an apostille.
- If not, we can initiate the video-attestation flow (we will send a short guide).
- Please attach a bank-letter or equivalent confirming payer details (company name, account number masked, and tax ID).

I’m looping in Kimberly from Procurement (cc) to start the PO workflow as soon as Docs are validated. Ben is on the thread for contract/pricing alignment.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Vendor Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

If procurement needs the apostille route we can request it, but that will take longer. Prefer to stay with DocuSign + bank letter if that meets Redwood's standard.

Sara —

DocuSign with the identity certificate plus the bank letter you provided is acceptable. We ran a quick check and the document set meets our standard evidence checklist for foreign vendors. Next steps from our side:

1) Kimberly will open the vendor profile and route to Finance for verification (cc’d).
2) Once Finance confirms the bank letter + DocuSign envelope certificate, Procurement will issue the initial PO (target: within 3 business days from verification).
3) We will provide the PO number and payment terms in a follow-up email. If Finance requests a UBO declaration, we’ll flag it in the same ticket — that would add a short delay.

Kimberly — please pick this up and advise on expected PO date. Ben — note for revenue ops: talk to accounting about any prepayment holds for new foreign vendors.

Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround. I’ll post the DocuSign envelope and HubSpot deal links below for your reference.

DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/abc123-envelope-id
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FFV-2029-1205

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Vendor Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
